name: Self-sown x402 payments
description: x402 v2 (exact scheme) over Bitcoin Lightning (lnbtc mainnet) for agent-paid endpoints on Self-sown, plus buyer-side tooling that can pay any external x402 Lightning challenge.

facilitation.details: No external facilitator is involved. On retry, the server validates the client-supplied preimage against the invoice payment hash (SHA-256(preimage) == payment_hash), validates invoice terms (amount, currency, expiry, payee signing key), enforces replay protection via an atomic settlement store, then executes the purchased operation.
facilitation.replayProtection: Every settled (network, payment hash) pair is recorded atomically; a preimage can never settle two requests.

headers.encoding: base64-encoded JSON (base64url tolerated on decode). The same JSON is also mirrored in the response body for clients that do not read headers.

requestBinding.hash: SHA-256 of the UTF-8 bytes of the JCS (RFC 8785) canonical binding object, domain-separated by 'x402:exact:lnbtc:bolt11:<profile>'.

http:1.bodyHash: sha256 of the JCS-canonicalized parsed JSON body. Deviation from the spec's raw-content-bytes hash: the framework pre-parses JSON bodies, so the hash covers JCS(parsed body) — identical to the raw-byte hash whenever the client sends canonical JSON.

mcp:1.notes: Binds server URI, tool name, and tool arguments. No _meta member is bound (none affect the purchased operation); the x402/payment member is always excluded.

invoiceBinding.strict: Seller-authority invoices (a Pro seller's own LNbits node) embed the request hash in the BOLT11 description-hash field — full spec-strict binding, verified at settlement.
invoiceBinding.relaxed: Platform-mint invoices cannot carry a caller-supplied description hash. Deviation from the spec: the request is bound server-side instead — the challenge, order, and payment hash are persisted before the invoice is exposed, and settlement re-derives all expectations from that stored record rather than client input.

createOrder.auth: Bearer MCP API key (https://self-sown.com/api/mcp/keys/onboard for a free keyless shopping key)
createOrder.challenge: 402 with L402 WWW-Authenticate header AND x402 PAYMENT-REQUIRED header/body when paymentMethod is lightning (default).
createOrder.settle: Retry the identical request with a PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header carrying { x402Version: 2, accepted: <requirements from the challenge>, payload: { preimage: <64 hex chars> } }.
createOrder.fallback: Paying the invoice with any Lightning wallet and polling POST /api/mcp/verify-payment with the orderId also settles the order.

mcp.createOrderSettlement: Retry the create_order tool call with the x402 payment payload in params._meta["x402/payment"] (payload object or base64 string).

buyerTool.name: pay_x402_request
buyerTool.description: Pays any HTTP 402 x402 v2 exact/lnbtc-mainnet challenge — on this marketplace or any external service — from the buyer's server-stored Cashu wallet. Validates scheme/network/asset/amount/expiry before spending, enforces a spend cap (default 100000 sats, absolute max 1000000), and returns the settlement receipt (payment hash + preimage) plus the unlocked resource response.

parameters.url: required — the URL returning the 402 challenge
parameters.headers: optional extra request headers, sent on both attempts
parameters.body: optional POST body, sent verbatim on both attempts
parameters.mintUrl: optional Cashu mint to pay from (default https://mint.minibits.cash/Bitcoin)

sellerInvoiceAuthority.description: Herd (Pro) sellers can point x402/MCP Lightning checkout at their own LNbits instance (Settings > Payments). Invoices are then issued by the seller's node with the request hash embedded (spec-strict binding) and funds settle directly to the seller's infrastructure. Requires a public https LNbits URL and an invoice/read API key; the key is verified on save and stored encrypted.
sellerInvoiceAuthority.management: /api/x402/authority (signed kind-27235 Nostr proof; GET reads, POST connects [Pro], DELETE disconnects)
